item.description: Grand Valley State University’s Senior Leadership Team (SLT) has seen significant changes in recent years. item.title: Native American Student Association hosts traditional clothing workshop
item.description: Encapsulating Native American resilience, students at Grand Valley State University gathered last Monday to sew ribbon skirts, a traditional Indigenous garment known for its vibrant hues, creative designs and extensive history. item.description: Last Thursday, in celebration of Women’s History Month, Grand Valley State University hosted guest speaker Janell Hobson to discuss the contributions of women throughout American history. item.description: Recent phishing emails at Grand Valley State University have raised concerns among students and faculty whose likenesses are being used to commit fraudulent check scams that could cost over $1,000. item.description: Grand Valley State University has abruptly eliminated four administrative staff positions within the Tutoring and Reading Center and Art Museum, and reorganized numerous other programs. item.description: This past week, Grand Valley State University’s Rainbow Resource Center hosted its annual Trans Week of Visibility. item.description: The Michigan Action for Cuba Committee (MACC) is hosting a medicine drive to help bring essential resources and supplies to Cuba, which is in an economic crisis. item.description: In February this year, Grand Valley State University abruptly altered a retiree benefit, upsetting many faculty members.
